words.gloss: embankments, wells, holy places, caityas, abodes of gods

words.gram: m. gen. sg. caus. pres. part. ni-√viś

hindi: कर्म और जल के उचित मार्ग को रोकने वाले अथवा अनुचित बनाने वाले का प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है; और दूसरे की भूमि पर बाँध, कुएँ, पुण्य-स्थान, चैत्य, देवों के आयतन स्थापित कराने वाले का —
english: For one who obstructs the customary path of work and water, or makes [one] that is not customary, the first fine for rashness; and for one who has embankments, wells, holy places, caityas and abodes of gods established on the land of another —
notes: The sentence has no verb or predicate after niveśayataḥ; the fine of the first clause presumably carries over, but nothing is supplied, so the translation is left open with a dash. karma-udaka-mārga: 'work' (karma) is not further specified; read as dvandva 'work and water' (alternatively 'path of the work of water'). 'pūrva' = first (glossary). caitya kept untranslated. para = 'the other', not 'enemy'.
lines_deva: कर्म.उदक.मार्गम् उचितं रुन्धतः कुर्वतो ऽनुचितं वा पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः, सेतु.कूप.पुण्य.स्थान.चैत्य.देव.आयतनानि च पर.भूमौ निवेशयतः
lines_iast: karma.udaka.mārgam ucitaṃ rundhataḥ kurvato 'nucitaṃ vā pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, setu.kūpa.puṇya.sthāna.caitya.deva.āyatanāni ca para.bhūmau niveśayataḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. caus. pres. part. √nī

hindi: पहले से चले आ रहे धर्म-सेतु को बन्धक या बिक्री तक ले जाने वाले अथवा ले जवाने वाले का मध्यम साहस-दण्ड है; सुनने वालों का सर्वोच्च; टूटे, त्यागे हुए को छोड़कर।
english: For one who brings, or causes to be brought, to pledge or to sale a dharma embankment continued from before, the middle fine for rashness; for the hearers, the highest; except in the case of the broken and abandoned.
notes: dharma-setu: literally 'dharma embankment' (a pious embankment/foundation?); sense not further fixed. śrotṝṇām 'of the hearers': who is meant (those who hear of or witness the deal?) is not stated; kept literal. Bare uttama = 'the highest', no noun supplied. bhagna-utsṛṣṭa: what is broken or abandoned is not stated (the embankment, presumably).
lines_deva: पूर्व.अनुवृत्तं धर्म.सेतुम् आधानं विक्रयं वा नयतो नाययतो वा मध्यमः साहस.दण्डः, श्रोतॄणाम् उत्तमः, अन्यत्र भग्न.उत्सृष्टात्
lines_iast: pūrva.anuvṛttaṃ dharma.setum ādhānaṃ vikrayaṃ vā nayato nāyayato vā madhyamaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ, śrotṝṇām uttamaḥ, anyatra bhagna.utsṛṣṭāt

hindi: स्वामी के अभाव में गाँव अथवा पुण्यशील प्रतिकार करें।
english: In the absence of an owner, the villages, or those of pious character, should remedy [it].

text_flags.why: possible missing compound mark: 'svāmy' stands for the compound member svāmi- (svāmi-abhāve 'in the absence of the owner'); elsewhere the e-text writes compounds with '.'

notes: Object of pratikuryuḥ is not stated (the harm/loss presumably); '[it]' is supplied. 'puṇya-śīlāḥ' is visarga-dropped before vā (regular), so no flag. pratikuryuḥ literally 'should counteract/make good'.
lines_deva: स्वाम्य् अभावे ग्रामाः पुण्य.शीला वा प्रतिकुर्युः
lines_iast: svāmy abhāve grāmāḥ puṇya.śīlā vā pratikuryuḥ

words.gloss: in the establishing of the fort

hindi: मार्ग के माप की व्याख्या दुर्ग के बसाने में की गई है।
english: The measure of paths has been explained in the establishing of the fort.
notes: Refers back to an earlier passage on settling a fort (presumably in Book 2); the reference is not stated in the line. pathi- is the compound form of pathin.
lines_deva: पथि.प्रमाणं दुर्ग.निवेशे व्याख्यातम्
lines_iast: pathi.pramāṇaṃ durga.niveśe vyākhyātam

words.gloss: path of small animals and men
path of cremation ground and village
path of provincial town, country and pasture

hindi: छोटे पशुओं और मनुष्यों का मार्ग रोकने वाले का दण्ड बारह पण है; बड़े पशुओं का मार्ग चौबीस पण का, हाथियों और खेतों का मार्ग चौवन पण का, सेतु और वन का मार्ग छह सौ का, श्मशान और ग्राम का मार्ग दो सौ का, द्रोणमुख का मार्ग पाँच सौ का, स्थानीय नगर, राष्ट्र और चरागाह का मार्ग एक हज़ार का।
english: For one who obstructs the path of small animals and men, the penalty is twelve paṇas; [for the] path of large animals, twenty-four paṇas; [for the] path of elephants and fields, fifty-four paṇas; [for the] path of embankments and woods, [a penalty] of six hundred; [for the] path of cremation ground and village, of two hundred; [for the] path of the droṇa-mukha, of five hundred; [for the] path of provincial town, country and pasture, of a thousand.

text_flags.why: possible missing compound dot: the parallel members are written ṣaṭ.śataḥ, pañca.śataḥ

notes: Ellipsis: rundhataḥ ('obstructing') governs all the paths; the later fines are bare number-adjectives with the noun daṇḍa understood. paṇa is stated only for the first three amounts; for 'of six hundred' etc. no unit is added (glossary). hasti-kṣetra-patha: 'path of elephants and fields' is one reading; 'path to an elephant-field/enclosure' is an alternative. droṇa-mukha kept as a name. sthānīya = provincial town; vivīta = pasture. Hindi leaves the elided verb unstated.
lines_deva: क्षुद्र.पशु.मनुष्य.पथं रुन्धतो द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, महा.पशु.पथं चतुर्.विंशति.पणः, हस्ति.क्षेत्र.पथं चतुष्.पञ्चाशत्.पणः, सेतु.वन.पथं षट्.शतः, श्मशान.ग्राम.पथं द्विशतः, द्रोण.मुख.पथं पञ्च.शतः, स्थानीय.राष्ट्र.विवीत.पथं साहस्रः
lines_iast: kṣudra.paśu.manuṣya.pathaṃ rundhato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, mahā.paśu.pathaṃ catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ, hasti.kṣetra.pathaṃ catuṣ.pañcāśat.paṇaḥ, setu.vana.pathaṃ ṣaṭ.śataḥ, śmaśāna.grāma.pathaṃ dviśataḥ, droṇa.mukha.pathaṃ pañca.śataḥ, sthānīya.rāṣṭra.vivīta.pathaṃ sāhasraḥ

hindi: और इनके अतिकर्षण में दण्ड, दण्ड के चौथाई हैं।
english: And in over-ploughing (ati-karṣaṇa) of these, the penalties are a fourth of the penalty.
notes: Doubtful. daṇḍa-caturtha is read as tat-puruṣa 'fourth part of the fine'. Alternative: bahuvrīhi 'having the fine as the fourth', i.e. the fine increased by a fourth. atikarṣaṇa is rendered literally ('drawing/ploughing beyond'); what is encroached on (the paths of unit 5) is inferred from eṣām ('of these'). Nothing else supplied.
lines_deva: अतिकर्षणे च-एषां दण्ड.चतुर्था दण्डाः
lines_iast: atikarṣaṇe ca-eṣāṃ daṇḍa.caturthā daṇḍāḥ

hindi: कर्षण में पहले कहे हुए।
english: In ploughing (karṣaṇa), those stated before.
notes: The noun (the fines, daṇḍāḥ) is not stated; none supplied. karṣaṇa literally 'drawing/ploughing'; contrast atikarṣaṇa in unit 6.
lines_deva: कर्षणे पूर्व.उक्ताः
lines_iast: karṣaṇe pūrva.uktāḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-√kṣip

words.gloss: from faults, mishaps and the unbearable

hindi: खेत वाले का, जो न डालता हो या उपवास का खेत छोड़ता हो, बीज के समय बारह पण का दण्ड है; दोष, आ पड़ने और असह्य को छोड़कर।
english: For a field-holder who is not casting [seed], or who abandons the field of an upavāsa, at seed-time, the penalty is twelve paṇas, except for faults, mishaps and what cannot be borne.
notes: Doubtful construction. akṣipataḥ is read as a-√kṣip 'not casting' (object, presumably seed, not stated; '[seed]' supplied from bīja-kāle). upavāsa is obscure (also in unit 16) and kept untranslated; genitive upavāsasya may qualify kṣetram ('field of an upavāsa') or mean 'to an upavāsa'. kṣetram may be shared by both participles. doṣa = fault, upanipāta = befalling/mishap (literal), aviṣahya = unbearable; what exactly is excused is not stated.
lines_deva: क्षेत्रिकस्य-अक्षिपतः क्षेत्रम् उपवासस्य वा त्यजतो बीज.काले द्वादश.पणो दण्डः, अन्यत्र दोष.उपनिपात.अविषह्येभ्यः
lines_iast: kṣetrikasya-akṣipataḥ kṣetram upavāsasya vā tyajato bīja.kāle dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra doṣa.upanipāta.aviṣahyebhyaḥ

hindi: कर देने वाले कर देने वालों में बन्धक अथवा बिक्री करें; ब्रह्मदेयिक ब्रह्मदेयिकों में।
english: Tax-payers should make a pledge or a sale among tax-payers; brahmadeyikas [should do so] among brahmadeyikas.
notes: brahma-deyika is kept as a term; it is an -ika derivative of brahma-deya, presumably 'holder of a brahma-gift' (a gift for a brahmin), but this is not stated in the line. The verb is not repeated for the second clause; '[should do so]' is supplied in English only.
lines_deva: करदाः करदेष्व् आधानं विक्रयं वा कुर्युः, ब्रह्म.देयिका ब्रह्म.देयिकेषु
lines_iast: karadāḥ karadeṣv ādhānaṃ vikrayaṃ vā kuryuḥ, brahma.deyikā brahma.deyikeṣu

hindi: अन्यथा प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है।
english: Otherwise, the first fine for rashness.
lines_deva: अन्यथा पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः
lines_iast: anyathā pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√viś

hindi: अथवा कर देने वाले का, जो कर न देने वालों के गाँव में प्रवेश करता है।
english: Or [in the case] of a tax-payer entering a village of non-tax-payers.
notes: No predicate is stated; it presumably continues unit 10 (the fine), but nothing is supplied. akarada-grāma could also be read 'non-tax-paying village'.
lines_deva: करदस्य वा-अकरद.ग्रामं प्रविशतः
lines_iast: karadasya vā-akarada.grāmaṃ praviśataḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√viś

hindi: किन्तु कर देने वाले में प्रवेश करने वाले की सब वस्तुओं में इच्छा की स्वतन्त्रता हो, घर को छोड़कर।
english: But of one entering a tax-paying [village], there would be freedom of will in all goods, except the house.
notes: Doubtful. karadam is masculine accusative 'tax-payer / tax-paying'; the noun (grāma 'village') is not stated and is bracketed in English only. Whose freedom of will (prākāmya) is meant, and over what, is not clear; kept literal (prākāmya = freedom of will, glossary). 'except the house' translates anyatra agārāt literally ('elsewhere than from the house').
lines_deva: करदं तु प्रविशतः सर्व.द्रव्येषु प्राकाम्यं स्यात्, अन्यत्र-अगारात्
lines_iast: karadaṃ tu praviśataḥ sarva.dravyeṣu prākāmyaṃ syāt, anyatra-agārāt

hindi: उसे वह भी दे।
english: [One] should give even that to him.
notes: 'that' (tat) is unspecified (the freedom of will of unit 12, or the house excepted there); the subject of dadyāt is not stated.
lines_deva: तद् अप्य् अस्मै दद्यात्
lines_iast: tad apy asmai dadyāt

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-√kṛṣ

words.gloss: by the redemption of the exertion

hindi: जो जोतता नहीं उसके न लेने योग्य को दूसरा पाँच वर्ष भोगकर प्रयास के निष्क्रय से दे।
english: Another, having enjoyed for five years what is not to be taken of one who is not ploughing, should give [it] by the redemption of the exertion.
notes: Doubtful. anādeyam is taken literally as 'not to be taken/accepted' (the thing meant, presumably the field, is not named; '[it]' is supplied). niṣkraya = redemption/ransom; prayāsa = exertion. The giver and the recipient are not stated.
lines_deva: अनादेयम् अकृषतो ऽन्यः पञ्च.वर्षाण्य् उपभुज्य प्रयास.निष्क्रयेण दद्यात्
lines_iast: anādeyam akṛṣato 'nyaḥ pañca.varṣāṇy upabhujya prayāsa.niṣkrayeṇa dadyāt

hindi: कर न देने वाले दूसरी जगह रहते हुए भोग पर निर्वाह करें।
english: Those who are not tax-payers, living elsewhere, should live on the enjoyment (bhoga).
notes: bhoga literally 'enjoyment' (usufruct/produce?); not specified. paratra 'in the other place'.
lines_deva: अकरदाः परत्र वसन्तो भोगम् उपजीवेयुः
lines_iast: akaradāḥ paratra vasanto bhogam upajīveyuḥ

words.gloss: for the interest of the village

hindi: ग्राम के प्रयोजन से जाते हुए ग्रामिक के पीछे उपवास बारी-बारी से चलें।
english: The upavāsas should follow in turn the village headman (grāmika) who is going for the interest of the village.
notes: upavāsa is obscure (cf. unit 8) and kept untranslated; Hindi उपवास here is not 'fast'. grāmika 'village headman' is the usual sense of the term; medium confidence. grāma-artha: artha = interest/purpose (glossary: प्रयोजन).
lines_deva: ग्राम.अर्थेन ग्रामिकं व्रजन्तम् उपवासाः पर्यायेण-अनुगच्छेयुः
lines_iast: grāma.arthena grāmikaṃ vrajantam upavāsāḥ paryāyeṇa-anugaccheyuḥ

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. an-anu-√gam

hindi: पीछे न चलने वाले प्रति योजन पण-अर्ध-पणिक दें।
english: Those who do not follow should give paṇa-ardha-paṇika per yojana.
notes: Doubtful, left literal. paṇa-ardha-paṇika could mean 'a paṇa or a half-paṇa', 'a paṇa and a half', 'half a paṇa' or 'worth half a paṇa'; no reading is imposed. 'per yojana' renders the accusative yojanam (yojana kept as a unit).
lines_deva: अननुगच्छन्तः पण.अर्ध.पणिकं योजनं दद्युः
lines_iast: ananugacchantaḥ paṇa.ardha.paṇikaṃ yojanaṃ dadyuḥ

words.gloss: one who is not a thief or adulterer

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. nir-√as

hindi: ग्रामिक के, ग्राम से जो चोर और परस्त्रीगामी न हो उसे निकालने वाले का चौबीस पण का दण्ड है; ग्राम का सर्वोच्च।
english: For a village headman who expels from the village one who is not a thief or an adulterer, the penalty is twenty-four paṇas; for the village, the highest.
notes: astena-pāradārika is read as a-stena-pāradārika with the negation covering both members ('not a thief or adulterer'), by the sense of a penalty for expelling; the other reading ('a thief or adulterer') would make the fine odd. 'grāmasya uttamaḥ' = for the village (collectively expelling), the highest [fine]; bare uttama, no noun supplied.
lines_deva: ग्रामिकस्य ग्रामाद् अस्तेन.पारदारिकं निरस्यतश् चतुर्.विंशति.पणो दण्डः, ग्रामस्य-उत्तमः
lines_iast: grāmikasya grāmād astena.pāradārikaṃ nirasyataś catur.viṃśati.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, grāmasya-uttamaḥ

hindi: क्योंकि निकाले हुए के प्रवेश की व्याख्या अभिगम से की गई है।
english: For the entry of one who has been expelled has been explained by approach (abhigama).
notes: abhigama is rendered literally as 'approach'; the earlier passage it refers to (a rule on approaching/going to) is not identified here.
lines_deva: निरस्तस्य प्रवेशो ह्य् अभिगमेन व्याख्यातः
lines_iast: nirastasya praveśo hy abhigamena vyākhyātaḥ

hindi: ग्राम से चारों ओर सौ धनुष दूर खम्भों से उपसाल बनवाए।
english: [One] should have an upasāla made with posts, on all sides, at a distance of a hundred dhanus from the village.
notes: upasāla is kept untranslated (a fence or hedge-like enclosure is possible, not certain). dhanus is the measure, kept as dhanus. Subject of kārayet not stated.
lines_deva: स्तम्भैः समन्ततो ग्रामाद् धनुः.शत.अपकृष्टम् उपसालं कारयेत्
lines_iast: stambhaiḥ samantato grāmād dhanuḥ.śata.apakṛṣṭam upasālaṃ kārayet

hindi: पशुओं के चरने के लिए चरागाह से काटने के द्वारा निर्वाह करें।
english: For the grazing of animals, [they] should live off the pasture by cutting (ālavana).
notes: ālavana taken literally as 'cutting/reaping' (ā-√lū); what is cut is not stated. The construction (living off the pasture by cutting) is literal; subject not stated.
lines_deva: पशु.प्रचार.अर्थं विवीतम् आलवनेन-उपजीवेयुः
lines_iast: paśu.pracāra.arthaṃ vivītam ālavanena-upajīveyuḥ

hindi: चरागाह को चरकर चले गए ऊँटों और भैंसों का चौथाई सिक्का लें; गाय-बैलों, घोड़ों, गधों का आधा चौथाई; छोटे पशुओं का सोलहवें भाग वाला।
english: Of camels and buffaloes that have eaten the pasture and gone away, they should take a quarter coin (rūpa); and of cattle, horses and donkeys, a half-quarter; of small animals, a sixteenth part.
notes: pādika rūpa is kept literal ('a coin of a quarter'): whether it is a quarter of a coin/paṇa or a coin of quarter value is not stated, and no unit is added. The noun after ardha-pādikam and ṣoḍaśa-bhāgikam is understood from the first clause (rūpam). gava is the compound form of go.
lines_deva: विवीतं भक्षयित्वा-अपसृतानाम् उष्ट्र.महिषाणां पादिकं रूपं गृह्णीयुः, गव.अश्व.खराणां च-अर्ध.पादिकम्, क्षुद्र.पशूनां षोडश.भागिकम्
lines_iast: vivītaṃ bhakṣayitvā-apasṛtānām uṣṭra.mahiṣāṇāṃ pādikaṃ rūpaṃ gṛhṇīyuḥ, gava.aśva.kharāṇāṃ ca-ardha.pādikam, kṣudra.paśūnāṃ ṣoḍaśa.bhāgikam

words.gram: m. gen. pl. pres. part. pari-√vas

hindi: चरकर बैठ जाने वालों के ये ही दण्ड दुगुने हैं; आसपास टिके रहने वालों के चौगुने।
english: For those that, having eaten, have settled down, these very penalties are doubled; for those staying around, fourfold.
notes: The beings meant (the animals of unit 22) are not named. 'eta' is ete with sandhi before eva; 'dvi.guṇā' is dviguṇāḥ with visarga dropped before d (regular).
lines_deva: भक्षयित्वा निषण्णानाम् एत एव द्वि.गुणा दण्डाः, परिवसतां चतुर्.गुणाः
lines_iast: bhakṣayitvā niṣaṇṇānām eta eva dvi.guṇā daṇḍāḥ, parivasatāṃ catur.guṇāḥ

words.gloss: whose ten days are not complete

hindi: ग्राम के देव-वृषभ, या जिसके दस दिन पूरे नहीं हुए, या दुधारू गाय, बैल और गो-वृषभ दण्ड के अयोग्य हैं।
english: Bulls of the village deity, or [one] whose ten days are not complete, or a milch cow, oxen and cattle-bulls are not to be punished.
notes: anirdaśa-ahā: literally 'whose ten days are not complete'; the event from which the days are counted (calving?) is not stated. grāma-deva-vṛṣa: 'bulls of the village deity' is a literal tat-puruṣa reading ('deity-bulls of the village' possible). The pairing 'vā ... vā' is kept as 'or ... or' only once in English. Alternative reading: anirdaśa-ahā qualifies dhenuḥ ('a milch cow whose ten days are not complete', one vā rendered); the translation keeps both vā as separate alternatives.
lines_deva: ग्राम.देव.वृषा वा-अनिर्दश.अहा वा धेनुर् उक्षाणो गो.वृषाश् च-अदण्ड्याः
lines_iast: grāma.deva.vṛṣā vā-anirdaśa.ahā vā dhenur ukṣāṇo go.vṛṣāś ca-adaṇḍyāḥ

hindi: फसल चरने पर, फसल की हानि को उपज से गिनकर दुगुना दिलवाए।
english: In the eating of crops, having reckoned the damage to the crop from the yield, [one] should have double given.
notes: Who pays and who receives is not stated. niṣpatti = yield/outturn (literal 'coming out').
lines_deva: सस्य.भक्षणे सस्य.उपघातं निष्पत्तितः परिसङ्ख्याय द्वि.गुणं दापयेत्
lines_iast: sasya.bhakṣaṇe sasya.upaghātaṃ niṣpattitaḥ parisaṅkhyāya dvi.guṇaṃ dāpayet

words.gram: m. acc. pl. or gen./abl. sg.
m. gen. sg. caus. pres. part. √car
m. gen. sg. pres. part. pra-√muc

hindi: और स्वामी को बताए बिना चराने वाले का बारह पण का दण्ड, छोड़ देने वाले का चौबीस पण का।
english: And for one who, without informing the owner, makes [them] graze, a penalty of twelve paṇas; for one who lets [them] loose, of twenty-four paṇas.

text_flags.why: typo: dental n for retroflex ṇ (daṇḍa)

notes: 'svāminaḥ' may be accusative plural 'owners' or genitive/ablative singular; read 'the owner'. The object of cārayataḥ and pramuñcataḥ (the animals) is not stated; '[them]' supplied in English. anivedya literally 'not having made known'.
lines_deva: स्वामिनश् च-अनिवेद्य चारयतो द्वादश.पणो दण्दः, प्रमुञ्चतश् चतुर्.विंशति.पणः
lines_iast: svāminaś ca-anivedya cārayato dvādaśa.paṇo daṇdaḥ, pramuñcataś catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ

hindi: रखवालों के आधे दण्ड हैं।
english: For keepers, half penalties.
notes: pālin 'keeper, protector' (herdsman is the likely sense, not stated).
lines_deva: पालिनाम् अर्ध.दण्डाः
lines_iast: pālinām ardha.daṇḍāḥ

hindi: साँड के चरने पर वही करे।
english: [One] should do that very thing in the eating by a bull (ṣaṇḍa).
notes: ṣaṇḍa read as 'bull' (the word can also mean eunuch/castrated animal); medium confidence. 'That' refers to the fines/steps of the preceding units; subject not stated.
lines_deva: तद् एव षण्ड.भक्षणे कुर्यात्
lines_iast: tad eva ṣaṇḍa.bhakṣaṇe kuryāt

words.gloss: gone to house, threshing floor, ring

hindi: बाड़ तोड़ने पर, और घर, खलिहान, घेरे में गए अनाजों के खाने पर दुगुना।
english: For breaking a fence, and for eating grains that have gone to a house, threshing floor or ring, double.

text_flags.why: possible missing comma: visarga stays before the voiced v of veśma, which is only regular before a pause

notes: Both locatives are read as governed by dvi-guṇaḥ 'double [the fine]' (the fine itself is not named). valaya literally 'ring/circle'; its exact sense here is not stated. khala = threshing floor (lexical). Alternative: dvi-guṇaḥ belongs only to the fence clause.
lines_deva: वाट.भेदे द्वि.गुणः वेश्म.खल.वलय.गतानां च धान्यानां भक्षणे
lines_iast: vāṭa.bhede dvi.guṇaḥ veśma.khala.valaya.gatānāṃ ca dhānyānāṃ bhakṣaṇe

hindi: हिंसा का प्रतिकार करे।
english: [One] should apply a remedy for harm.
notes: Whether the harm is done by the animals or to the animals is not stated. Subject not stated.
lines_deva: हिंसा.प्रतीकारं कुर्यात्
lines_iast: hiṃsā.pratīkāraṃ kuryāt

hindi: अभय-वन के पशु या पकड़कर रखे हुए, खाते हुए, स्वामियों को बताकर, जैसे वध के अयोग्य हैं वैसे रोके जाने चाहिए।
english: Animals of the safe forest, or those held captive, when eating, should be warded off, after informing the owners, just as [they are] not to be killed.
notes: yathā avadhyāḥ tathā ...: literally 'as [they are] not to be killed, so [they] should be warded off'; the sense may be 'in such a way that they are not killed'. Whose owners (of the crops or of the held animals) is not stated. mṛga rendered 'animals' (deer or wild animals). abhaya-vana = 'safe forest' (literal 'fearless').
lines_deva: अभय.वन.मृगाः परिगृहीता वा भक्षयन्तः स्वामिनो निवेद्य यथा-अवध्यास् तथा प्रतिषेद्धव्याः
lines_iast: abhaya.vana.mṛgāḥ parigṛhītā vā bhakṣayantaḥ svāmino nivedya yathā-avadhyās tathā pratiṣeddhavyāḥ

hindi: पशु रस्सी और प्रतोद से रोके जाने चाहिए।
english: Animals are to be restrained with rein and goad.
notes: raśmi literally 'rein/rope'; pratoda 'goad'.
lines_deva: पशवो रश्मि.प्रतोदाभ्यां वारयितव्याः
lines_iast: paśavo raśmi.pratodābhyāṃ vārayitavyāḥ

hindi: उनकी अन्य प्रकार से हिंसा करने पर दण्ड-पारुष्य के दण्ड हैं।
english: In the case of harm to them otherwise, the penalties are those for physical injury (daṇḍa-pāruṣya).
notes: daṇḍa-pāruṣya = physical injury in Book 3 (glossary, with vāk-pāruṣya). The line does not say who is harmed or by whom.
lines_deva: तेषाम् अन्यथा हिंसायां दण्ड.पारुष्य.दण्डाः
lines_iast: teṣām anyathā hiṃsāyāṃ daṇḍa.pāruṣya.daṇḍāḥ

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. pra-√arth

hindi: चाहने वाले अथवा जिनका अपराध देखा गया हो, सब उपायों से रोके जाने चाहिए। यह खेत और मार्ग की हिंसा है।
english: Those who are seeking, or whose offence has been seen, are to be restrained by all means. Such is the harm of fields and paths.
notes: The line contains the printed verse-number marker '| 34 |' and a closing label 'iti kṣetra-patha-hiṃsā', which closes the first part of the chapter; this label belongs with this unit. prārthayamānāḥ: object not stated (animals or persons are both possible); kept literal. Closing iti is glossed 'closing particle' and rendered 'Such is'.
lines_deva: प्रार्थयमाना दृष्ट.अपराधा वा सर्व.उपायैर् नियन्तव्याः । ३४ । इति क्षेत्र.पथ.हिंसा
lines_iast: prārthayamānā dṛṣṭa.aparādhā vā sarva.upāyair niyantavyāḥ | 34 | iti kṣetra.patha.hiṃsā

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. a-√kṛ

hindi: किसान के ग्राम में आकर न करने पर ग्राम ही अत्यय ले।
english: In the case of a cultivator who, having come to the village, does not do [it], the village itself should take the penalty (atyaya).
notes: abhyupetya literally 'having come to / approached' (accepted the village, i.e. joined it); the object of akurvataḥ (the work) is not stated. atyaya = penalty (glossary 5.2 sense where plain); haret literally 'should take/seize'. Medium confidence on both.
lines_deva: कर्षकस्य ग्रामम् अभ्युपेत्य-अकुर्वतो ग्राम एव-अत्ययं हरेत्
lines_iast: karṣakasya grāmam abhyupetya-akurvato grāma eva-atyayaṃ haret

words.gloss: double the pay for the work
in not giving food and drink

hindi: कर्म न करने पर कर्म के वेतन का दुगुना, धन न देने पर प्रति अंश दुगुना, और प्रहवणों में भक्ष्य और पेय न देने पर दुगुना अंश दे।
english: For not doing the work, double the pay for the work; for not giving money, double for each share; and for not giving food and drink at the prahavaṇas, [one] should give a double share.
notes: dadyāt is read as governing all three clauses; the first two have only the elliptical 'double'. prahavaṇa is obscure and kept untranslated. hiraṇya = money (glossary). karma = work (service sense).
lines_deva: कर्म.अकरणे कर्म.वेतन.द्वि.गुणम्, हिरण्य.अदाने प्रत्यंश.द्वि.गुणम्, भक्ष्य.पेय.अदाने च प्रहवणेषु द्वि.गुणम् अंशं दद्यात्
lines_iast: karma.akaraṇe karma.vetana.dvi.guṇam, hiraṇya.adāne pratyaṃśa.dvi.guṇam, bhakṣya.peya.adāne ca prahavaṇeṣu dvi.guṇam aṃśaṃ dadyāt

hindi: प्रेक्षा में अंश न देने वाला, अपने जनों सहित न देखे।
english: At a spectacle, one who gives no share — together with his own people, should not watch.

text_flags.why: possible: the hyphen (unsandhied join) probably stands for a compound dot, since sa- 'with' forms a bahuvrīhi with sva-jana

notes: sa-sva.jana is read as bahuvrīhi 'together with his own people' (sa = 'with'). Alternative: sa = saḥ 'he' as a separate word. anaṃśadaḥ read as nominative singular 'one who gives no share'.
lines_deva: प्रेक्षायाम् अनंशदः, स-स्व.जनो न प्रेक्षेत
lines_iast: prekṣāyām anaṃśadaḥ, sa-sva.jano na prekṣeta

hindi: छिपकर सुनने-देखने में और सबके हित के कार्य में निग्रह से दुगुना अंश दे।
english: In hidden hearing and seeing, and in work beneficial to all, [one] should give a double share by restraint (nigraha).
notes: nigraha literally 'restraint' (compulsion or penalty are possible); the exact sense of 'by restraint' is not fixed. Subject not stated.
lines_deva: प्रच्छन्न.श्रवण.ईक्षणे च सर्व.हिते च कर्मणि निग्रहेण द्वि.गुणम् अंशं दद्यात्
lines_iast: pracchanna.śravaṇa.īkṣaṇe ca sarva.hite ca karmaṇi nigraheṇa dvi.guṇam aṃśaṃ dadyāt

hindi: सबके हित की बात कहने वाले एक की आज्ञा पूरी करें।
english: They should carry out the order of one who speaks what is beneficial to all.
notes: Literal: 'of one speaking what is beneficial to all, they should do the order'. ekasya may also be read 'of a single (person)'.
lines_deva: सर्व.हितम् एकस्य ब्रुवतः कुर्युर् आज्ञाम्
lines_iast: sarva.hitam ekasya bruvataḥ kuryur ājñām

hindi: न करने पर बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: For not doing [it], a penalty of twelve paṇas.
notes: The object of akaraṇe (the order of unit 39) is not stated in the line.
lines_deva: अकरणे द्वादश.पणो दण्डः
lines_iast: akaraṇe dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ

hindi: अथवा यदि वे मिलकर उसे मारें, तो इनमें से प्रत्येक पर अलग से अपराध का दुगुना दण्ड है।
english: Or if, having combined, they strike him, separately for each of these, a penalty double the offence.
notes: vā is read as 'or' linking this case to unit 40; the alternative reading is 'if they strike him together or [singly]'. √han 'strike/kill' is ambiguous; Hindi मारें covers both. aparādha-dviguṇa: literally 'double of the offence'.
lines_deva: तं चेत् सम्भूय वा हन्युः पृथग् एषाम् अपराध.द्वि.गुणो दण्डः
lines_iast: taṃ cet sambhūya vā hanyuḥ pṛthag eṣām aparādha.dvi.guṇo daṇḍaḥ

hindi: प्रहार करने वालों में विशिष्ट।
english: Among the strikers, the distinguished.
notes: Literal. The noun is not stated (a person or a fine); what makes him viśiṣṭa and what follows from it is not said. upahantṛ = one who strikes or injures.
lines_deva: उपहन्तृषु विशिष्टः
lines_iast: upahantṛṣu viśiṣṭaḥ

hindi: और इनमें ब्राह्मण ज्येष्ठता के लिए नियुक्त किया जाए।
english: And a brahmin should be appointed to seniority among these.
notes: Doubtful. ni-√yam literally 'restrain, regulate'; read 'appoint' because of the next unit (brahmins' share at the prahavaṇas). Alternative: 'a brahmin should be restricted/regulated in respect of the seniority of these'.
lines_deva: ब्राह्मणश् च-एषां ज्यैष्ठ्यं नियम्येत
lines_iast: brāhmaṇaś ca-eṣāṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ niyamyeta

hindi: और इनके प्रहवणों में ब्राह्मण अनिच्छुक होकर न करें, और अंश पाएँ।
english: And at their prahavaṇas brahmins should not act unwillingly, and should receive a share.
notes: The object of kuryuḥ is not stated. 'na akāmāḥ kuryuḥ' is read 'should not do [it] unwilling'; the double negative 'should act willing' is the alternative. prahavaṇa untranslated.
lines_deva: प्रहवणेषु च-एषां ब्राह्मणा न-अकामाः कुर्युः, अंशं च लभेरन्
lines_iast: prahavaṇeṣu ca-eṣāṃ brāhmaṇā na-akāmāḥ kuryuḥ, aṃśaṃ ca labheran

words.gloss: of regions, jātis, families and saṅghas

hindi: इससे देश, जाति, कुल और संघों के समझौते के अस्वीकार न करने की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By that, the non-rejection of the agreement of regions, jātis, families and saṅghas is explained.
notes: anapākarma (an-apākarman) is literally 'non-rejection' (apa-ā-√kṛ); the sense may be 'not breaking/undoing'. jāti kept (birth-group). saṅgha kept as saṅgha (glossary 11.1), here a corporate body; not translated 'republic'. Formula 'tena X vyākhyātam' follows the glossary.
lines_deva: तेन देश.जाति.कुल.सङ्घानां समयस्य-अनपाकर्म व्याख्यातम्
lines_iast: tena deśa.jāti.kula.saṅghānāṃ samayasya-anapākarma vyākhyātam

hindi: जो देश के लिए हितकारी बाँध, मार्ग में पुल, ग्राम की शोभाएँ और रक्षाएँ बनाते हैं, उनके प्रति राजा प्रिय और हित का आचरण करे।
english: The king should practise what is agreeable and beneficial toward those who make embankments beneficial to the region, crossings on the path, and village adornments and protections.
notes: priya-hita is kept literal 'the agreeable and beneficial' (glossary 5.4). saṅkrama literally 'crossing' (bridge or causeway); 'protections' (rakṣāḥ) is literal and not specified. Two half-verse lines; the metre (8+8) fits anuṣṭubh.
lines_deva: राजा देश.हितान् सेतून् कुर्वतां पथि सङ्क्रमान्
ग्राम.शोभाश् च रक्षाश् च तेषां प्रिय.हितं चरेत्
lines_iast: rājā deśa.hitān setūn kurvatāṃ pathi saṅkramān
grāma.śobhāś ca rakṣāś ca teṣāṃ priya.hitaṃ caret
